name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Carlisle PA

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed the large cross-dock DC at 1200 Distribution Dr, Carlisle PA (I-81 logistics park, Cumberland County). Roster ROOFTOP geocode landed on the roof of the SOUTHERN of two adjacent GXO buildings; the northern building is GXO's 1301 Distribution Dr (a separate roster-noted facility). Locked center on the southern building (1200).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (2021) at the SW driveway clearly shows a controlled entrance: chain-link sliding gates across the lanes with a center island, plus a 'NO TRUCKS' sign segregating a car lane from the truck lane. The whole truck yard is enclosed by continuous chain-link perimeter fencing. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth structure at the gate — Street View and z21 satellite show gates, an island, and signage but no 1-3-vehicle booth. guardShack = false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present with no guard booth => remote check-in (kiosk / badge / app). remoteGs = true.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: separate dock banks on the north face and the south face, each with its own fenced truck yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two very long dock banks (N and S faces) with many trailers backed in; estimated ~110 total, banded 50+ (count low-confidence on a building of this size).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated herringbone trailer drop yard off the SE corner holding dozens of trailers; well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved apron / divided approach road outside the SW gate with room for trucks to wait before the gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and divided approach road; clear room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Carlisle is a small Cumberland County borough; the facility sits in an I-81 industrial park on the rural edge surrounded by farmland. Per rubric, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.

citations.claim: GXO careers lists 1200 and 1301 Distribution Drive, Carlisle PA 17013 with active June 2026 postings

verification.rationale: GXO careers names both 1200 and 1301 Distribution Dr with current reqs; the Carlisle GXO WARN closure is at a different address (100 Carolina Way).
